definitions.short: the lobe or flap of the liver (as if redundant or outhanging)
definitions.full: H3508. yothereth יֹתֶ֫רֶת noun feminine appendage (technical term of P); — most probably (fat) appendage , a (fatty) mass at opening of liver of sacrificial animal, extending to kidneys (see Di Dr Polychr. Bible, Lev 3:4 ); **GFM (Dec. 28, 1899, privately points out that fat parts are always distinguished from this; compare now on יתדת Id. SACRIFICE EB 4206 and especially Id. Oriental. Stud. für Th. Nöldeke (1906), 761 , where it is shewn to be the caudate lobe of the liver. — עַלהַֿכָּבֵד הַיֹּתֶרֶת Exod 29:13 ; Lev 3:4 , 10 , 15 ; 4:9 ; 7:4 ; ׳הַיּ מִןהַֿכָּבֵד 9:10 ; construct הַכָּבֵד יֹתֶרֶת Exod 29:22 ; Lev 8:16 , 25 ; 9:19 (all P).

occurrences.englishText: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.

Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),
and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.
He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;
but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
